title: Position Forcing: Self-Conditioning 3D Generation
title_zh: Position Forcing: 自条件的3D生成

paragraphs.en: Recent single-stage 3D generative models commonly adopt VecSet representations, encoding 3D shapes as unordered sets of latent tokens. However, compared with two-stage methods that provide explicit positional guidance, these models must implicitly infer token positions throughout denoising, limiting their generation quality. We observe that, despite the absence of explicit positional conditioning, VecSet tokens retain recoverable spatial correspondences. Building on this observation, we propose Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning framework. During denoising, Position Forcing recovers token positions from the current clean latent estimate, quantizes them at progressively finer resolutions according to the denoising stage, and feeds the resulting positional encodings back into the diffusion Transformer. This progressively refined positional feedback provides spatial guidance at a granularity appropriate to each denoising stage, guiding shape generation along a coarse-to-fine trajectory and substantially improving generation quality without a separate position generation stage. Experiments demonstrate that Position Forcing achieves strong performance among single-stage 3D generative methods and outperforms several competitive multi-stage approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的单阶段三维生成模型通常采用 VecSet 表示法，将三维形状编码为无序的潜在令牌集合。 然而，与提供明确位置引导的双阶段方法相比，这些模型必须在整个去噪过程中隐式推断令牌的位置，从而限制了其生成质量。 我们观察到，尽管没有明确的位置条件约束，VecSet 令牌仍然保留了可恢复的空间对应关系。 基于这一观察，我们提出了“位置强制”（Position Forcing），一种基于位置的自条件框架。 在去噪过程中，“位置强制”会从当前的干净潜在估计中恢复令牌的位置，根据去噪阶段以逐步更精细的分辨率对其进行量化，并将得到的位置编码反馈到扩散 Transformer 中。 这种逐步精细化的位置反馈为每个去噪阶段提供了适当粒度的空间引导，使形状生成沿着从粗到细的轨迹进行，并在无需单独的位置生成阶段的情况下显著提升了生成质量。 实验表明，“位置强制”在单阶段三维生成方法中表现出色，并优于多种具有竞争力的多阶段方法。

paragraphs.en: 3D content is a fundamental component of the digital world, supporting a wide range of applications in gaming, filmmaking, and virtual reality [ Xu et al., 2024 , Wang et al., 2026c , Gong et al., 2026 ] . However, creating high-quality 3D assets typically requires specialized modeling expertise and substantial manual effort, making it difficult to meet the growing demand for 3D content. Recent advances in generative models have enabled the automatic synthesis of high-quality 3D assets conditioned on images or text, offering new opportunities to make 3D creation more accessible and efficient. In particular, diffusion- and flow-based generative models [ Ho et al., 2020 , Rombach et al., 2022 , Lipman et al., 2023 , Peebles and Xie, 2023 , Ma et al., 2024 , Wang et al., 2026a , Zhou et al., 2025 , Ouyang et al., 2026 ] have been widely adopted for 3D geometry generation, substantially improving generation quality and practical usability [ Zhao et al., 2023 , Zhao et al., 2025 , Li et al., 2025b , Wang et al., 2026b ] .

paragraphs.en: To efficiently model complex 3D geometry, recent 3D generative methods widely adopt VecSet-style representations, which compress shapes into a compact set of latent tokens and enable generative modeling in an efficient latent space [ Zhang et al., 2023 , Zhao et al., 2023 , Li et al., 2024 , Zhao et al., 2025 ] . During generation, however, the model starts from a set of unordered noise tokens. Without explicit positional guidance, the model must establish both the spatial organization of the tokens and their corresponding geometric representations within a single denoising process, making generative modeling more challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 为了高效地模拟复杂的三维几何结构，近期的三维生成方法广泛采用了 VecSet 风格的表示方式，这种表示方式将形状压缩为紧凑的潜在令牌集合，从而能够在高效的潜在空间中实现生成建模 [ Zhang et al., 2023 , Zhao et al., 2023 , Li et al., 2024 , Zhao et al., 2025 ] 。 然而，在生成过程中，模型是从一组无序的噪声令牌开始的。 在没有明确的位置引导的情况下，模型必须在单次去噪过程中同时建立令牌的空間组织及其对应的几何表示，这使得生成建模更具挑战性。

sents.en: During generation, however, the model starts from a set of unordered noise tokens.
sents.zh: 然而，在生成过程中，模型是从一组无序的噪声令牌开始的。

sents.en: Without explicit positional guidance, the model must establish both the spatial organization of the tokens and their corresponding geometric representations within a single denoising process, making generative modeling more challenging.
sents.zh: 在没有明确的位置引导的情况下，模型必须在单次去噪过程中同时建立令牌的空間组织及其对应的几何表示，这使得生成建模更具挑战性。

paragraphs.en: To alleviate this difficulty, recent methods adopt multi-stage generation paradigms and achieve substantial improvements in generation quality [ Xiang et al., 2025 , Lai et al., 2026 , Xiang et al., 2026 ] . These methods typically first generate a coarse spatial structure to explicitly determine where geometric content should reside, and then use this structure to guide fine-grained geometry generation. This explicit spatial guidance facilitates subsequent geometry modeling but relies on a separate structure-generation model and an additional sampling stage. We therefore seek to obtain explicit spatial guidance directly within a single-stage generation process, without introducing an additional structure-generation stage.
paragraphs.zh: 为缓解这一难题，近期方法采用了多阶段生成范式，并在生成质量上取得了显著提升 [ Xiang et al., 2025 , Lai et al., 2026 , Xiang et al., 2026 ] 。 这些方法通常首先生成一个粗略的空间结构，以明确几何内容应位于何处，然后利用该结构引导精细几何的生成。 这种明确的空间引导有助于后续的几何建模，但需要依赖一个独立的结构生成模型以及额外的采样阶段。 因此，我们试图在单阶段生成过程中直接获得明确的空间引导，而无需引入额外的结构生成阶段。

sents.zh: 因此，我们试图在单阶段生成过程中直接获得明确的空间引导，而无需引入额外的结构生成阶段。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we further investigate the spatial properties of VecSet latent representations. In a VecSet VAE with point queries, each latent token is constructed from a corresponding spatial query and is therefore associated with a query position. We observe that this positional correspondence is retained in the encoded latent representation. As shown in Fig. 1 (I), the corresponding query positions can be recovered from the latent tokens alone, indicating that the unordered VecSet representation retains decodable spatial information.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们进一步研究了 VecSet 潜在表示的空间属性。 在带有点查询的 VecSet VAE 中，每个潜在标记都由一个对应的空间查询构建而成，因此与一个查询位置相关联。 我们观察到，这种位置对应关系在编码后的潜在表示中得以保留。 如图 1 (I) 所示，仅通过潜在标记即可恢复出对应的查询位置，这表明无序的 VecSet 表示保留了可解码的空间信息。

sents.zh: 为此，我们进一步研究了 VecSet 潜在表示的空间属性。

sents.en: We observe that this positional correspondence is retained in the encoded latent representation.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，这种位置对应关系在编码后的潜在表示中得以保留。

sents.en: As shown in Fig. 1 (I), the corresponding query positions can be recovered from the latent tokens alone, indicating that the unordered VecSet representation retains decodable spatial information.
sents.zh: 如图 1 (I) 所示，仅通过潜在标记即可恢复出对应的查询位置，这表明无序的 VecSet 表示保留了可解码的空间信息。

paragraphs.en: Since this positional information can be recovered from latent tokens, a natural idea is to feed the recovered positions back into the model as explicit spatial conditioning during generation. To this end, we first consider a naive design that predicts token positions from the current noisy latent during both training and inference and constructs positional encodings at full spatial resolution, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (II)(c). However, we find that this direct approach often produces shapes with incorrect geometry. At high noise levels, position predictions are unreliable, and full-resolution positional encodings can make the model rely on incorrect fine-grained spatial relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 由于这种位置信息可以从潜在令牌中恢复，一个自然的想法是在生成过程中将恢复的位置作为显式的空间条件反馈到模型中。 为此，我们首先考虑一种简单的设计：在训练和推理阶段都从当前的噪声潜在状态预测令牌位置，并以完整空间分辨率构建位置编码，如图 1 (II)(c) 所示。 然而，我们发现这种直接方法通常会生成几何结构错误的形状。 在高噪声水平下，位置预测并不可靠，而全分辨率的位置编码可能会使模型依赖错误的精细空间关系。

paragraphs.en: Building on these observations, we propose Position Forcing , a position-based self-conditioning framework that provides spatial guidance through progressively refined positional feedback. We first introduce a progressive position quantization strategy governed by the noise level, matching the granularity of spatial conditioning to the current generation step. At high noise levels, we quantize positions onto a coarse spatial grid to preserve global layout information while reducing sensitivity to positional errors. As the noise level decreases, we progressively increase the quantization resolution, refining positional guidance from global layout to local spatial relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些观察，我们提出了“位置强制”（Position Forcing）——一种基于位置的自条件框架，通过逐步精细的位置反馈提供空间引导。 我们首先引入了一种由噪声水平控制的渐进式位置量化策略，使空间条件的颗粒度与当前生成步骤相匹配。 在高噪声水平下，我们将位置量化到粗粒度的空间网格上，以保留全局布局信息，同时降低对位置错误的敏感度。 随着噪声水平的降低，我们逐步提高量化分辨率，将位置引导从全局布局细化到局部空间关系。

paragraphs.en: To further reduce the impact of noise on position recovery and provide more accurate positional guidance, we consider recovering token positions from the predicted clean latent representation. Specifically, during inference, we use the model-predicted velocity field to compute the predicted clean latent, recover token positions from it, and progressively quantize them, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (II)(d). These positional conditions are fed back into the diffusion Transformer through RoPE, providing coarse-to-fine spatial guidance for subsequent denoising. To further improve generation quality, we train the model with accurate query positions using the same quantization. Together, these designs enable Position Forcing to continually update spatial guidance within a single denoising trajectory, guiding generation from global layout to fine-grained local geometry without a separate position generation stage.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步减少噪声对位置恢复的影响并提供更精确的位置引导，我们考虑从预测的干净潜在表示中恢复标记位置。 具体而言，在推理阶段，我们使用模型预测的速度场来计算预测的干净潜在表示，从中恢复标记位置，并逐步对其进行量化，如图 1 (II)(d) 所示。 这些位置条件通过 RoPE 反馈到扩散 Transformer 中，为后续的降噪过程提供从粗略到精细的空间引导。 为了进一步提升生成质量，我们使用相同的量化方法，基于精确的查询位置对模型进行训练。 这些设计共同使得位置强制能够在单次降噪轨迹中持续更新空间引导，从而无需单独的位置生成阶段，即可将生成过程从全局布局引导至精细的局部几何结构。

paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，VecSet 的潜在标记保留了可解码的空间信息，从而能够以高精度恢复其对应的查询位置。

paragraphs.en: We propose Position Forcing , a self-conditioning framework that combines position quantization with position recovery from predicted clean latents to provide increasingly precise spatial guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了位置强制（Position Forcing）——一种自条件化框架，它将位置量化与从预测的干净潜在变量中恢复位置相结合，以提供越来越精确的空间引导。

paragraphs.en: Our method guides generation along a coarse-to-fine spatial trajectory, enabling high-quality single-stage 3D generation without a separate position generation stage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法沿着从粗略到精细的空间轨迹引导生成过程，从而无需单独的位置生成阶段，即可实现高质量的单阶段 3D 生成。

paragraphs.en: Generation Ordering and Self-Conditioning. Generation ordering structures information emergence through noise schedules or generation hierarchies. Diffusion Forcing [ Chen et al., 2024 ] , Latent Forcing [ Baade et al., 2026 ] , and Self-Flow [ Chefer et al., 2026 ] explore differentiated noise or information levels, while VAR [ Tian et al., 2024 ] , FlowAR [ Ren et al., 2024a ] , NVG [ Wang et al., 2026d ] , and Trajectory Forcing [ Kocabas et al., 2026 ] organize generation through spatial scales, token granularity, or structured intermediate states. Such designs allow earlier structural information to serve as context for subsequent detail generation. Complementarily, Analog Bits [ Chen et al., 2022 ] and RIN [ Jabri et al., 2022 ] perform self-conditioning by reusing clean-sample predictions and internal latent states, respectively. These mechanisms allow subsequent denoising steps to build on previously computed information and progressively refine the output.
paragraphs.zh: 生成顺序与自条件化。 生成顺序通过噪声调度或生成层次结构来组织信息的出现。 Diffusion Forcing [ Chen et al., 2024 ]、Latent Forcing [ Baade et al., 2026 ] 和 Self-Flow [ Chefer et al., 2026 ] 探索了差异化的噪声或信息水平，而 VAR [ Tian et al., 2024 ]、FlowAR [ Ren et al., 2024a ]、NVG [ Wang et al., 2026d ] 和 Trajectory Forcing [ Kocabas et al., 2026 ] 则通过空间尺度、词元粒度或结构化的中间状态来组织生成过程。 这类设计使得早期的结构信息能够作为后续细节生成的上下文。 与此互补的是，Analog Bits [ Chen et al., 2022 ] 和 RIN [ Jabri et al., 2022 ] 分别通过复用干净样本的预测结果和内部潜在状态来实现自条件化。 这些机制使得后续的降噪步骤能够基于先前计算出的信息，并逐步优化输出结果。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , our framework comprises two main components: Position VAE and Position-Forced DiT. Position VAE augments the geometry decoder with a position decoder that recovers the spatial positions associated with latent tokens. During denoising, Position-Forced DiT uses this position decoder to recover positions from the current clean latent estimate. These positions are quantized at progressively finer resolutions as the noise level decreases and fed back into the DiT through RoPE, providing coarse-to-fine spatial guidance for single-stage 3D generation.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，我们的框架包含两个主要组件：位置 VAE 和强制位置 DiT。 位置 VAE 通过增加一个位置解码器来增强几何解码器，该解码器能够恢复与潜在标记相关的空间位置。 在去噪过程中，强制位置 DiT 利用这个位置解码器从当前的干净潜在估计中恢复位置信息。 随着噪声水平降低，这些位置会在越来越精细的分辨率上进行量化，并通过 RoPE 反馈到 DiT 中，从而为单阶段 3D 生成提供从粗略到精细的空间引导。

paragraphs.en: Joint training makes the corresponding token positions easier to recover from the latent representations. paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 (b), Position-Forced DiT provides explicit spatial guidance for geometry generation through progressively refined positional conditions. paragraphs.en: Progressive Position Quantization. We evaluate progressive position quantization by comparing (b) and (c). Configuration (b) uses a fixed position resolution of 128 throughout denoising, whereas (c) progressively increases the conditioning resolution. Qualitatively, (b) exhibits fragmented structures around the house and irregular character surfaces, while (c) reduces these artifacts and produces better geometry. paragraphs.en: Position Recovery from Predicted Clean Latents. We first examine the source of position recovery during inference by comparing (c) and (d). paragraphs.en: Ground-Truth Query Conditioning during Training. We evaluate ground-truth query conditioning during training by comparing (d) and (f). Both configurations use progressive quantization and recover positions from x 0 x_{0} during inference, while (d) uses predicted positions during training and (f) uses ground-truth query positions. Compared with (d), (f) produces cleaner local structures on the house and more complete character geometry, while improving both ULIP metrics. We further compare (e) and (f), which share the same query-conditioned DiT checkpoint and differ only in the source of position recovery during inference. Direct position prediction from noisy latents in (e) still produces substantial geometric artifacts, whereas recovery from x 0 x_{0} in (f) markedly improves geometric completeness and all four metrics. This comparison suggests that recovering positions from predicted clean latents provides more accurate positional estimates, enabling better generation performance for the model trained with ground-truth queries.

paragraphs.en: Joint VAE Training. Finally, we evaluate joint VAE training by comparing our full configuration (f) with configuration (g). Configuration (g) replaces the jointly trained VAE with the Stage-I VAE and retrains the DiT under otherwise identical settings. Compared with (g), (f) reduces fragmented structures and better preserves details, while achieving higher scores on all four metrics, demonstrating improved generation quality. paragraphs.en: Analysis of Positional Feedback. We analyze the consistency between recovered and final generated positions during sampling to understand the roles of progressive quantization and clean-latent position recovery. As shown in Fig. 5 , progressive quantization improves overall accuracy across the sampling trajectory. Together, these designs provide coarse-to-fine spatial guidance that better aligns with the final generated positions.

paragraphs.en: We presented Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning framework for single-stage 3D generation. Our key observation is that VecSet latents retain correspondences with their spatial queries, enabling positional guidance to be recovered directly from geometry latents. Position VAE enables position recovery from geometry latents, while Position-Forced DiT uses the recovered positions as spatial guidance during denoising. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance against both single-stage and multi-stage methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了位置强制（Position Forcing），这是一种基于位置的单阶段三维生成自条件框架。 我们的关键发现是，VecSet 潜在变量保留了与其空间查询的对应关系，从而可以直接从几何潜在变量中恢复位置引导信息。 位置 VAE 能够从几何潜在变量中恢复位置，而位置强制 DiT（Position-Forced DiT）则在去噪过程中使用这些恢复的位置作为空间引导。 实验结果表明，该方法在性能上与单阶段和多阶段方法均具有竞争力。

sents.en: We presented Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning framework for single-stage 3D generation.
sents.zh: 我们提出了位置强制（Position Forcing），这是一种基于位置的单阶段三维生成自条件框架。

sents.en: Our key observation is that VecSet latents retain correspondences with their spatial queries, enabling positional guidance to be recovered directly from geometry latents.
sents.zh: 我们的关键发现是，VecSet 潜在变量保留了与其空间查询的对应关系，从而可以直接从几何潜在变量中恢复位置引导信息。

sents.en: Position VAE enables position recovery from geometry latents, while Position-Forced DiT uses the recovered positions as spatial guidance during denoising.
sents.zh: 位置 VAE 能够从几何潜在变量中恢复位置，而位置强制 DiT（Position-Forced DiT）则在去噪过程中使用这些恢复的位置作为空间引导。

sents.en: Experiments demonstrate competitive performance against both single-stage and multi-stage methods.
sents.zh: 实验结果表明，该方法在性能上与单阶段和多阶段方法均具有竞争力。

paragraphs.en: Position VAE uses latent tokens with 64 channels. The geometry encoder and decoder contain 8 and 16 Transformer layers, respectively, while the position decoder contains 4 Transformer layers. During VAE training, we perturb the query coordinates before positional encoding, independently sampling each offset component from 𝒰 ( − 1 / 64 , 1 / 64 ) \mathcal{U}(-1/64,1/64) . We first train the position decoder with the pretrained VAE frozen, then jointly finetune the encoder, geometry decoder, and position decoder. The position loss and KL regularization weights are set to λ pos = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{pos}}=1 and λ KL = 10 − 6 \lambda_{\mathrm{KL}}=10^{-6} , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 位置 VAE 使用具有 64 个通道的潜在标记。 几何编码器和解码器分别包含 8 层和 16 层 Transformer，而位置解码器则包含 4 层 Transformer。 在 VAE 训练期间，我们在进行位置编码之前对查询坐标进行扰动，并将每个偏移分量从 𝒰 ( − 1 / 64 , 1 / 64 ) \mathcal{U}(-1/64,1/64) 中独立采样。 我们首先使用已预训练的、保持冻结的 VAE 训练位置解码器，然后联合微调编码器、几何解码器和位置解码器。 位置损失和 KL 正则化权重分别设置为 λ pos = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{pos}}=1 和 λ KL = 10 − 6 \lambda_{\mathrm{KL}}=10^{-6}。

sents.zh: 位置 VAE 使用具有 64 个通道的潜在标记。

sents.en: The geometry encoder and decoder contain 8 and 16 Transformer layers, respectively, while the position decoder contains 4 Transformer layers.
sents.zh: 几何编码器和解码器分别包含 8 层和 16 层 Transformer，而位置解码器则包含 4 层 Transformer。

sents.zh: 在 VAE 训练期间，我们在进行位置编码之前对查询坐标进行扰动，并将每个偏移分量从 𝒰 ( − 1 / 64 , 1 / 64 ) \mathcal{U}(-1/64,1/64) 中独立采样。

sents.en: We first train the position decoder with the pretrained VAE frozen, then jointly finetune the encoder, geometry decoder, and position decoder.
sents.zh: 我们首先使用已预训练的、保持冻结的 VAE 训练位置解码器，然后联合微调编码器、几何解码器和位置解码器。

sents.en: The position loss and KL regularization weights are set to λ pos = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{pos}}=1 and λ KL = 10 − 6 \lambda_{\mathrm{KL}}=10^{-6} , respectively.
sents.zh: 位置损失和 KL 正则化权重分别设置为 λ pos = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{pos}}=1 和 λ KL = 10 − 6 \lambda_{\mathrm{KL}}=10^{-6}。

paragraphs.en: We use a FLUX-based Transformer architecture [ Labs, 2024 ] with 12 double-stream blocks and 24 single-stream blocks, a hidden dimension of 1536, 16 attention heads, and an MLP expansion ratio of 4. For 3D RoPE, we allocate 32 channels to each spatial axis and set the frequency base to 10,000. Image conditions are extracted using DINOv2-Giant, concatenated with the geometry tokens, and jointly processed by the FLUX-based Transformer. Training images have a resolution of 518 × 518 518\times 518 , and image conditions are dropped with probability 0.1 to support classifier-free guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用基于 FLUX 的 Transformer 架构 [ Labs, 2024 ]，包含 12 个双流块和 24 个单流块，隐藏维度为 1536，注意力头数为 16，MLP 扩展比为 4。 对于 3D RoPE，我们为每个空间轴分配 32 个通道，并将频率基值设为 10,000。 图像条件通过 DINOv2-Giant 提取，与几何标记拼接后，由基于 FLUX 的 Transformer 联合处理。 训练图像的分辨率为 518 × 518 518\times 518，并以 0.1 的概率丢弃图像条件，以支持无分类器引导。

sents.en: We use a FLUX-based Transformer architecture [ Labs, 2024 ] with 12 double-stream blocks and 24 single-stream blocks, a hidden dimension of 1536, 16 attention heads, and an MLP expansion ratio of 4.
sents.zh: 我们采用基于 FLUX 的 Transformer 架构 [ Labs, 2024 ]，包含 12 个双流块和 24 个单流块，隐藏维度为 1536，注意力头数为 16，MLP 扩展比为 4。

sents.zh: 对于 3D RoPE，我们为每个空间轴分配 32 个通道，并将频率基值设为 10,000。

sents.en: Image conditions are extracted using DINOv2-Giant, concatenated with the geometry tokens, and jointly processed by the FLUX-based Transformer.
sents.zh: 图像条件通过 DINOv2-Giant 提取，与几何标记拼接后，由基于 FLUX 的 Transformer 联合处理。

sents.en: Training images have a resolution of 518 × 518 518\times 518 , and image conditions are dropped with probability 0.1 to support classifier-free guidance.
sents.zh: 训练图像的分辨率为 518 × 518 518\times 518，并以 0.1 的概率丢弃图像条件，以支持无分类器引导。

paragraphs.en: Position VAE remains frozen throughout DiT training. We first train the DiT with 4096 latent tokens and subsequently continue training with 6144 tokens. Timesteps for flow-matching training are sampled uniformly from [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . We use AdamW with a base learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.99 \beta_{2}=0.99 , weight decay of 0.01, and ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon=10^{-6} . The learning rate follows a 500-step warmup followed by cosine decay, and gradients are clipped to a maximum norm of 1.0.
paragraphs.zh: VAE 的位置在整个 DiT 训练过程中保持冻结。 我们首先使用 4096 个潜在标记训练 DiT，随后继续使用 6144 个标记进行后续训练。 流匹配训练的时步从 [0,1] 中均匀采样。 我们使用 AdamW，其基础学习率为 2×10⁻⁵，β₁=0.9，β₂=0.99，权重衰减为 0.01，且 ε=10⁻⁶。 学习率采用 500 步的预热阶段，随后进行余弦衰减，并且梯度被裁剪至最大范数 1.0。

sents.en: Position VAE remains frozen throughout DiT training.
sents.zh: VAE 的位置在整个 DiT 训练过程中保持冻结。

sents.en: We first train the DiT with 4096 latent tokens and subsequently continue training with 6144 tokens.
sents.zh: 我们首先使用 4096 个潜在标记训练 DiT，随后继续使用 6144 个标记进行后续训练。

sents.en: Timesteps for flow-matching training are sampled uniformly from [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .
sents.zh: 流匹配训练的时步从 [0,1] 中均匀采样。

sents.en: We use AdamW with a base learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.99 \beta_{2}=0.99 , weight decay of 0.01, and ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon=10^{-6} .
sents.zh: 我们使用 AdamW，其基础学习率为 2×10⁻⁵，β₁=0.9，β₂=0.99，权重衰减为 0.01，且 ε=10⁻⁶。

sents.en: The learning rate follows a 500-step warmup followed by cosine decay, and gradients are clipped to a maximum norm of 1.0.
sents.zh: 学习率采用 500 步的预热阶段，随后进行余弦衰减，并且梯度被裁剪至最大范数 1.0。

paragraphs.en: For the progressive resolution schedule in Eq. 10 , we set m min = − 1 m_{\min}=-1 , m max = 9 m_{\max}=9 , R min = 1 R_{\min}=1 , and R max = 128 R_{\max}=128 . This schedule maintains a single spatial cell at high noise levels, progressively refines the grid, and retains the maximum resolution during the final part of denoising. Quantized coordinates at all resolutions are mapped to a common reference coordinate system with resolution 128. During DiT training, positional perturbation is activated independently for each sample with probability 0.5 and applied after quantization and coordinate mapping. Each coordinate offset takes a value in { − 1 , 0 , 1 } \{-1,0,1\} , with a fixed magnitude in this reference coordinate system regardless of the current quantization resolution. Perturbations are disabled when R = 1 R=1 so that all tokens share the same positional encoding, and are not used during inference.
paragraphs.zh: 对于公式 10 中的渐进式分辨率调度方案，我们设置 m min = − 1 m_{\min}=-1、m max = 9 m_{\max}=9、R min = 1 R_{\min}=1 以及 R max = 128 R_{\max}=128。 该调度方案在高噪声水平下保持单个空间单元，逐步细化网格，并在去噪的最后阶段保留最大分辨率。 所有分辨率下的量化坐标都会被映射到一个分辨率为 128 的通用参考坐标系中。 在 DiT 训练期间，位置扰动会以 0.5 的概率为每个样本独立激活，并在量化和坐标映射之后应用。 每个坐标偏移量的取值范围是 { − 1 , 0 , 1 } \{-1,0,1\}，在此参考坐标系中其大小固定，与当前的量化分辨率无关。 当 R = 1 R=1 时，扰动会被禁用，这样所有标记都会共享相同的位置编码，并且在推理阶段不会使用。

sents.en: For the progressive resolution schedule in Eq. 10 , we set m min = − 1 m_{\min}=-1 , m max = 9 m_{\max}=9 , R min = 1 R_{\min}=1 , and R max = 128 R_{\max}=128 .
sents.zh: 对于公式 10 中的渐进式分辨率调度方案，我们设置 m min = − 1 m_{\min}=-1、m max = 9 m_{\max}=9、R min = 1 R_{\min}=1 以及 R max = 128 R_{\max}=128。

sents.en: This schedule maintains a single spatial cell at high noise levels, progressively refines the grid, and retains the maximum resolution during the final part of denoising.
sents.zh: 该调度方案在高噪声水平下保持单个空间单元，逐步细化网格，并在去噪的最后阶段保留最大分辨率。

sents.en: Quantized coordinates at all resolutions are mapped to a common reference coordinate system with resolution 128.
sents.zh: 所有分辨率下的量化坐标都会被映射到一个分辨率为 128 的通用参考坐标系中。

sents.en: During DiT training, positional perturbation is activated independently for each sample with probability 0.5 and applied after quantization and coordinate mapping.
sents.zh: 在 DiT 训练期间，位置扰动会以 0.5 的概率为每个样本独立激活，并在量化和坐标映射之后应用。

sents.en: Each coordinate offset takes a value in { − 1 , 0 , 1 } \{-1,0,1\} , with a fixed magnitude in this reference coordinate system regardless of the current quantization resolution.
sents.zh: 每个坐标偏移量的取值范围是 { − 1 , 0 , 1 } \{-1,0,1\}，在此参考坐标系中其大小固定，与当前的量化分辨率无关。

sents.en: Perturbations are disabled when R = 1 R=1 so that all tokens share the same positional encoding, and are not used during inference.
sents.zh: 当 R = 1 R=1 时，扰动会被禁用，这样所有标记都会共享相同的位置编码，并且在推理阶段不会使用。

paragraphs.en: At inference time, we use 12288 latent tokens and input images of resolution 1022 × 1022 1022\times 1022 . We perform 50-step Euler sampling with classifier-free guidance (CFG) at a guidance scale of 5.0, using BF16 precision. The initial step uses R = 1 R=1 , and subsequent steps obtain positional conditions from the clean latent prediction of the preceding step. The conditional and unconditional CFG branches share the same positional conditions. The generated latents are decoded by the geometry decoder of Position VAE. Meshes are extracted using the dmc mode at a resolution of 512 with an isosurface threshold of 0.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段，我们使用 12288 个潜在标记和分辨率为 1022 × 1022 的输入图像。 我们以 5.0 的指导尺度，使用 BF16 精度执行 50 步的欧拉采样，并配合无分类器引导（CFG）。 初始步骤使用 R = 1，后续步骤则从前一步骤的干净潜在预测中获取位置条件。 有条件和无条件 CFG 分支共享相同的位置条件。 生成的潜在数据由 Position VAE 的几何解码器进行解码。 网格通过 dmc 模式以 512 的分辨率和 0 的等值面阈值提取。

sents.en: At inference time, we use 12288 latent tokens and input images of resolution 1022 × 1022 1022\times 1022 .
sents.zh: 在推理阶段，我们使用 12288 个潜在标记和分辨率为 1022 × 1022 的输入图像。

sents.en: We perform 50-step Euler sampling with classifier-free guidance (CFG) at a guidance scale of 5.0, using BF16 precision.
sents.zh: 我们以 5.0 的指导尺度，使用 BF16 精度执行 50 步的欧拉采样，并配合无分类器引导（CFG）。

sents.en: The initial step uses R = 1 R=1 , and subsequent steps obtain positional conditions from the clean latent prediction of the preceding step.
sents.zh: 初始步骤使用 R = 1，后续步骤则从前一步骤的干净潜在预测中获取位置条件。

sents.en: The conditional and unconditional CFG branches share the same positional conditions.
sents.zh: 有条件和无条件 CFG 分支共享相同的位置条件。

sents.en: The generated latents are decoded by the geometry decoder of Position VAE.
sents.zh: 生成的潜在数据由 Position VAE 的几何解码器进行解码。

sents.en: Meshes are extracted using the dmc mode at a resolution of 512 with an isosurface threshold of 0.
sents.zh: 网格通过 dmc 模式以 512 的分辨率和 0 的等值面阈值提取。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the core training and inference procedures of Position Forcing. During training, we quantize the query positions associated with the frozen VAE encoder to provide spatial guidance to the DiT. During inference, positions recovered from the predicted clean latents are quantized at the next step’s resolution to condition subsequent denoising. Here, rope_idx denotes the quantized coordinates used to construct 3D RoPE within the DiT. For clarity, the pseudocode omits training-time positional perturbations and image-condition dropout.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 总结了位置强制法的核心训练和推理流程。 在训练阶段，我们将与冻结的 VAE 编码器相关的查询位置进行量化，以为 DiT 提供空间引导。 在推理阶段，从预测的干净潜在变量中恢复出的位置将在下一步的分辨率上进行量化，以作为后续去噪的条件。 此处，rope_idx 表示用于在 DiT 内部构建 3D RoPE 的量化坐标。 为清晰起见，伪代码省略了训练时的位置扰动和图像条件 dropout。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 7 presents additional image-conditioned 3D generation results across diverse categories, including plants, stylized characters, buildings, and mechanical objects. These examples illustrate the ability of Position Forcing to capture both overall shape and local geometric details, such as thin plant leaves, character ornaments, architectural elements, and mechanical components.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了在不同类别中，基于图像的额外 3D 生成结果，包括植物、风格化角色、建筑物和机械物体。 这些示例表明，位置强制方法能够捕捉整体形状和局部几何细节，例如植物的细长叶片、角色的装饰元素、建筑构件以及机械部件。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 8 presents generated 3D shapes from multiple viewpoints to further assess the geometric quality of regions not visible in the conditioning images. Compared with the baseline, Position Forcing produces smoother surfaces and more geometrically plausible local details in rear views, including more regular building windows, better-preserved mechanical components, and cleaner character backs. These results further demonstrate the advantages of Position Forcing in surface quality and local geometric detail.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 展示了从多个视角生成的三维形状，以便进一步评估在条件图像中不可见的区域的几何质量。 与基线方法相比，位置强制法在后方视角中产生了更光滑的表面和更具几何合理性的局部细节，包括更规整的建筑窗户、更完好的机械部件以及更干净的人物背部。 这些结果进一步证明了位置强制法在表面质量和局部几何细节方面的优势。

We use a fixed 50-step sampling schedule and show the predicted clean sample x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} at selected generation steps.
